title: Trip Status and Dispatch Rules for Wayfare Rides
content:
Every trip on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** carries a status, moved by the rider and driver apps and the dispatch system.

## Rules

1. A request is accepted only for a ride option offered in the rider's market and for no more seats than the ride option's most seats per request; the ride option, the market and the seats are read from the request record.
2. An on-demand request that no driver accepts within the ride option's dispatch timeout is closed as unfulfilled; a reserved trip with no confirmed driver the ride option's reserved dispatch cutoff after the reserved pickup time is closed as unfulfilled. An unfulfilled trip is never charged anything except a reservation fee that is then refunded.
3. The rider may cancel at any time before pickup; once a trip is in progress it can only be completed.
4. A driver cancellation, whenever it happens, never charges the rider and leaves no fee or waiver entry.
5. Status changes on a trip are made by the rider and driver apps and the dispatch system as they happen; support never moves a trip from one status to another.

## Statuses and how a trip moves between them

| From | To | Moved by | What happened |
|---|---|---|---|
| requested | accepted | system | a driver accepts an on-demand request in the driver app |
| scheduled | accepted | system | a driver confirms a reserved trip ahead of the reserved pickup time |
| accepted | driver arrived | system | the driver marks arrival at the pickup point |
| driver arrived | in progress | system | the rider is picked up and the driver starts the trip |
| in progress | completed | system | the driver ends the trip at drop-off; the fare is charged |
| requested | rider cancelled | rider | the rider cancels an on-demand request before any driver accepts |
| scheduled | rider cancelled | rider | the rider cancels a reserved trip before a driver confirms it |
| accepted | rider cancelled | rider | the rider cancels after a driver accepted and before the driver arrived |
| driver arrived | rider cancelled | rider | the rider cancels after the driver arrived and before pickup |
| accepted | driver cancelled | system | the driver cancels the accepted trip before arriving |
| driver arrived | driver cancelled | system | the driver cancels after arriving, before the no-show wait has run out |
| driver arrived | rider no-show | system | the driver marks the rider as a no-show once the no-show wait has run out; the app does not offer the button earlier |
| requested | unfulfilled | system | no driver accepted the on-demand request within the dispatch timeout |
| scheduled | unfulfilled | system | no driver was confirmed for a reserved trip by the reserved dispatch cutoff |

A trip starts as **requested** (on demand) or **scheduled** (reserved through Wayfare Reserve). Completed, rider cancelled, driver cancelled, rider no-show and unfulfilled are the statuses in which a trip ends.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A rider asks support to mark an in-progress trip as cancelled. Support never moves a trip between statuses, and an in-progress trip can only be completed.
- A reserved trip with a hypothetical dispatch cutoff of 15 minutes and a reserved pickup time of 08:00 has no confirmed driver at 08:15: it is closed as unfulfilled, and any reservation fee charged on it is refunded.
